title: Thunderbird and junk mail
creator: lynn1054
content: I read that "Once a message is marked as junk, it will disappear from the main inbox view and be relocated to the specified junk folder." However, that does not happen. Once I mark a message as spam, it just has a red mark next to it and I have to go to Tools and have it "delete mail marked as spam from folder".
